label: probe-22
system: You design the cheapest experiment that would settle whether an idea is worth building. You are not a marketer. You care about one thing: what is the least money and least time that would produce a number capable of changing the founder's mind. Output JSON only.
user:
Design ONE real-world probe for this idea.

IDEA
{
  "id": 22,
  "title": "Nani's Words",
  "unlock": "A full-scale model with vision now runs on the phone itself at zero marginal cost, offline and private, so a card-by-card language drill costs nothing to serve however many times a day it is used.",
  "pain": "Language and habit apps in crowded categories died of distribution and of segment thinness rather than of cost - Habitual sat in a category with hundreds of near-identical entrants and never found a channel [63], and Refolo could not find a segment for whom the problem was acute enough to pay [65].",
  "audience": "Second-generation British Punjabi and Gujarati adults in their twenties and thirties who understand their grandparents but cannot reply",
  "mechanic": "spaced_repetition",
  "wedge": "The fifty phrases you need for a Sunday phone call to one named grandmother, recorded in her own voice and resurfaced on the schedule you are forgetting them on.",
  "moat": "switching_cost_of_history",
  "model": "freemium_subscription",
  "loop": "community_embed",
  "kill": [
    "fewer than 25% of people who complete a first week are still reviewing on day 30",
    "fewer than 10 of the first 50 paying users can name a relative they have actually spoken more to since starting",
    "on-device inference fails or is unavailable on more than 40% of installed handsets, forcing cloud cost above $0.30 per active user per month",
    "fewer than 100 of the first 1,000 sign-ups arrive through a temple, gurdwara, community class or family group chat rather than paid placement"
  ],
  "why_not_obvious": "The obvious suggestion is a general heritage-language course, but the acute version is not fluency at all - it is fifty phrases for one recurring phone call with one specific person whose voice is the study material.",
  "why_now": "The drill loop that works for medical students has always cost nothing but attention, and now the voice and the grading cost nothing either because both run on the handset [2][4], which is what a crowded, thin-margin category needed [63]."
}

WHERE IT STANDS
{
  "novelty": 0.958,

  "founder_score": 50.5
}

Available probe kinds and their realistic costs:
- landing_page: a page plus $50-$150 of paid traffic. Measures whether anyone
  clicks and leaves an email.
- ad_ab: $50 split across two positioning messages. Measures which message pulls.
- community_post: free. A post in the exact forum where the affected population
  already gathers. Measures whether people reply saying they need this.
- concierge: free. Deliver the outcome by hand to five people for two weeks.
  Measures whether they come back.
- fake_door: free. A control for a feature that does not exist yet, inside
  something you already have. Measures intent.

Pick the ONE that would most change your mind per dollar, given what is already
uncertain about this specific idea. Do not default to a landing page.

Return JSON:
{
  "kind": "<one of the five>",
  "hypothesis": "the specific belief being tested, stated so it could be false",
  "falsifier": "the number or observation that would kill the idea, with a threshold",
  "budget_usd": <number>,
  "days": <number>,
  "exactly_what_to_do": ["3-6 concrete steps a person could follow on a Saturday"],
  "what_it_cannot_tell_you": "the thing this probe will NOT settle, stated plainly"
}
